configs.from: Which VAV Box sheet item this line is: a VAV box (a VAV or CAV terminal box); the VAV Integrator; a BACnet over IP controller; a duct connection; a conical piece; integrator cabling (per metre); or the installation of a VAV box of any size. from.title: ^The BACnet controller share spreads
from.why: "1 backnet controlor is required for every 32 VAVs ... we calculate the total price of the backnet controlor required and then amortize it over the number of VAVs" (owner 2026-11-20 14:18); any BACnet mention, every box gets the share, rounded to the rupee (14:22, 14:23 "allbxes getshare also", 14:25)

from.title: ^The DP sensor share spreads

from.title: ^The DDC panel share spreads
from.why: "DDC controllor price is worked as a sum of (Bacnet cost + DP Sensor cost + 25000) supply BCS and 5000 install BCS. standard markups apply. 1 panel is sufficient for upto 200 VAVs ... if we are including the price of DDC, then we dont add bacnet or DP sensor price separately" (owner 2026-11-20 14:30); "Bacnet cost will be rate*qty required" (14:31); 0.6 on the installation (14:39); supply only of the controllers and sensors (15:23); a DDC mention without 'inclusive' still adds it, with its note (14:42, 14:45); no minimum number of VAVs (15:02)

from.title: ^A shared item priced on its own row of the sheet is not added
from.why: a separate row for the item -> nothing added, a note names the row; presence decides, no quantity test (owner 2026-11-20 00:37 "VAV controlers have one to many mapping"; 15:20); an integrator / router row counts only for the integrator, never as the controller's own row (19:46 "integrator row does not count for controller it counts only for integrator"; 19:50, on 'Network controller or Router' rows) -- unless its own words make it a controller FOR THE VAVs, even if also called a router (20:20 "yes these rows are bacnet controlloer ...": 'Router / Supervisory Controller ... to monitor and Control the VAVs'); a row whose own description says it controls the VAVs is the controller's row even with no BACnet word (20:54: BOQ-26-00098 r70 'VAV Master Controller ... monitor and control all VAV status'); a separate row with quantity 0 on a sheet whose VAV rows carry a quantity does not count as charged separately - the share is added with a note (21:05, agreed; 20:56 "but the quantity for the master controller is zero, then we should price it with the Vav rows")
